Card Q&A.q: When I use this card's  effect to digivolve into a Digimon card with [ShineGreymon] in its name in the hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?

Card Q&A.a: It comes from the cards in your hand. This card's  effect has been changed to "1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [ShineGreymon] in its name in the hand without paying the cost."
